marketplaceEntry.name: eli5
marketplaceEntry.description: Explain any topic like I'm 5: a dead-simple HTML picture explainer with big visuals and few words. Use /eli5 <topic>.

files.content:
# eli5

Explain any topic like I'm 5.

```
/eli5 how does DNS work
```

Produces a HTML artifact with big pictures and very few words that explains the topic to someone who knows nothing about it.

name: eli5
